latin: Aristoteles in libro Methaphysicae de deo non tractat nisi in ultimo capitulo duodecimi quod incipit: Considerandum est etiam utronam modo uniuersum habet bonum.
translation: In the book of the Metaphysics, Aristotle treats of God only in the last chapter of the twelfth book, which begins: 'It must also be considered in which of the two ways the universe possesses the good.'
